# About 

I'm currently a lecturer in bioinformatics at the University of Hong Kong. I teach fundamental biostatistics, biounformatics and machine learning courses. Prior to my current position, I worked at HKJC Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention at the University of Hong Kong. By training, I am a data scientist and industrial engineer. I specializes in analyzing and leveraging data and technology to promote mental health at both individual and population levels.
